trigger.note: 12 V trigger in/out only — no RS-232 protocol exists for this power amp.

controlOptions.title: 12 V trigger only
controlOptions.summary: The RB-1590 (and RB-1552/RB-1582) expose only a 3.5 mm trigger jack. There is no command protocol.
controlOptions.limitations: Front-panel power switch overrides the trigger.
